note: REVIEWED semantic declarations — the semantic source of truth for the engineering surface index (T-1 redesign). Discovered facts live in the generated index, never here. A tool absent from both 'tools' and 'known_unclassified_baseline' that is executable FAILS CI. The baseline grandfathers the pre-index population; it only ever shrinks as tools get reviewed and declared. UNCLASSIFIED is an honest state, never a guess.
